Source/PuddingWebApiTests/PuddingWebApiT.note: 3 failures, all environment-induced (see reasonGroups.environmentKeyVault); not counted here

environmentKeyVault.reason: Test initialization throws InvalidOperationException: environment variable PUDDING_KEYVAULT_MASTER_KEY is not valid Base64. The variable is present only in the parent process environment (length 44, not base64), so any dotnet test launched from this agent session inherits it and PuddingWebApiTests.* TestInitialize fails before any production code runs. Unrelated to tool exposure; remove once the variable is a valid base64 key or is unset for test runs.
